# Chocolate Kids Pre-School

> A joyful Montessori preschool at Jagmal Chowk, Torwa, Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh — nurturing curious little stars since 2013 on a 5,000 sq ft campus with play areas, gardens and warm teachers.

Founded in 2013. Jovial preschool with Hindi and English recitation programs, annual sports, art and craft activities.

## Key Details

- **Address**: Jagmal Chowk, opposite Yamaha Showroom, NH-200, Torwa, Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh 495001
- **Email**: info@chocolatekids.co.in
- **Phone**: 087199 95554
- **Hours**: Mon–Sat, 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM
